violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Raw shell eggs observed stored over cooked chicken wings in 1 Dr UR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Chicken moved to above eggs.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: cooked chicken wings cooked two days prior observed without date marking.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. Date added to chicken.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: Raw shell eggs used in Ramen Soups.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. Provide EHS with proof that eggs are Pasteurized or provide consumer advisory to menu.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. Observed employee wash their hands in the 3 vat sink and the prep sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS instructed employees to wash hands with soap and water in the handsink.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw shell eggs stored over coffee creamers in 1 Dr display unit.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Food items moved to have eggs on bottom shelving.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Equipment food-contact surfaces/utensils were not observed cleaned before any possible contamination. Observed boiled egg cooker with grease and debris.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. Egg cooker taken to wash rinse and sanitize

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Portioned commercial kimchi (72F) observed in grab and go display
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed scoop for boba stored in ambient container of water.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Scoop washed rinsed and sanitized and returned in dry container.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Grab and Go reach in cooler observed not plugged in, ambient thermometer displayed 70F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Unit turned on.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment. Observed ventless fryer unit in establishment without approval.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: Ventless Fryer Unit. THE RAMYUN ZIP (Inspection Date: 10/09/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Hot Holding

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS discussed relationship between time and temperature with PIC. Employee agreed to only keep warmed boba for a max of 4hours.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. Obtain food thermometer with a probe.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers for seasoning were observed reused for the storage of other seasonings.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS discussed container usage with PIC.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. 3 compartment sink observed with a maximum temperature of 100F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. A follow up visit will be conducted to ensure the sink is able to reach 110F.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. No CFM present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM arrived during the inspection.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: DOK Employee Health Policy
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide a verbal or written policy for preventing the transmission of foodborne disease by an employee who has a disease or a medical condition. -EHS provided copy of the recommended employee health policy to PIC.
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge or certified food manager is responsible for knowledge, of at least the primary foodborne diseases (the Big 6) and medical conditions, to determine possible restriction or exclusion of food employees. EHS will follow up to ensure EHP is in place.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS provided copy of the V&D instructions. THE RAMYUN ZIP (Inspection Date: 04/17/2025) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Hot dog (50F), Bean sprouts (48F), and half n half (54F) observed in 1 Dr display. Onigiris and fried chicken from another vendor source observed in ambient.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. -Items discarded from cooler unit. -EHS discussed requirement for receiving temperatures for food items, please do not accept any deliveries which are not in proper hot holding or cold holding temperatures. Chicken and onigiris were delivered at 12pm per PIC, items discarded by 4pm.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location in Holding Units
violations.observation: The temperature measuring device in the following mechanically refrigerated unit was not properly located in the warmest part of the unit: 1 Dr Display unit, 2 Dr UCR unit
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanically refrigerated unit the sensor of a temperature measuring device shall be located to measure the air temperature of a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of the refrigerator. Store the thermometer near the door of the unit.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. -Onions observed on floor of kitchen area under the 3 compartment sink. -Drinks observed stored on the floor outside of kitchen by bathroom area.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Ice scoops and drink utensils observed stored in ambient water.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not finished to have a smooth, cleanable surface: KIMBAP SLICER, LUCKYENG KIMBAP MACHINE, SUN MACHINE, FRIGIDAIRE MINI ICE MACHINE
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be finished to have a smooth, easily cleanable surface. PROVIDE SPECIFICATION SHEETS FOR EQUIPMENT FOR REVIEW, DO NOT UTILIZE MACHINES UNTIL APPROVED.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1 Dr Display unit observed at 53F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. TCS items discarded.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system to the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PROVIDE PROOF OF BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE OR DISCONNECT FROM WATER SOURCE.

violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.
